versions.content: Parallel OBD and UDS processing Description: Diagnostics shall support the parallel processing of OBD and UDS protocols. Rationale: Vehicles can be equipped with On-board testers which send diagnostic requests at any arbitrary point in time. Legislative OBD requests need to be processed independently from a UDS requests from On-board testers. Use Case: Parallel reception of diagnostic requests from multiple testers. AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
